tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ṭikka bshad bsgribs su byas pa las skabs dang po'i tshig 'grel bzhugs/

na mo ā rya mai tri yi/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i ston pa shākya'i tog /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /shing rta chen po klu sgrub thogs med sogs/ /'dzam gling rgyan gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras smra ba'i khyu mchog saidga bzang*/ /rgyal pa'i dam chos kun 'dzin tsong kha pa/ /rgyal tshab mkhas grub rje btsun bstan dar sogs/ /dam pa'i bshes gnyen rnams la gus btud nas/ /sher phyin rgya mtsho'i sbas don rin chen gyi/ /bzhin ras rgyan gyi me long yangs pa'i ngos/ /'char kun gsal bar ston pa'i thabs kyi mchog /ṭikka snang byed sgron me sbar bar bya/ /de la 'dir rang cag rnams kyi ston pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dren pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis/ lus can mtha' dag sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog la 'god pa'i ched du/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar bla med byang chub mngon du mdzad nas/ gdul bya rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor zhing*/ de las brjod bya'i ngos nas rab dang phul du gyur pa ni/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum po 'di nyid yin te/ 'di'i bstan don la dngos bstan stong nyid gtso bor ston pa'i rim pa dang*/ sbas don mngon rtogs ston pa'i rim pa gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po'i dbang du byas nas dpal dgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rtsa ba shes rab la sogs pa dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs drug mdzad/ phyi ma gtso bor 'grel ba la/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan sogs mdzad pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi nang nas phyi ma'i dgongs pa gtso bor 'grel ba'i dbang du byas na/ de yang rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i shing rta chen po thogs med ces bya ba de nyid kyis rje btsun byams mgon bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs te/

yum gyi mdo'i tshig don ma lus pa rdzogs par gsan zhing*/ rje btsun gyis kyang phyis rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du sher phyin gyi mdo'i sbas don thams cad phyin ci ma log pa rdzogs par 'grel par byed pa'i bstan bcos chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba 'di nyid mdzad nas gnang bas/ slar 'dzam bu gling du byon te dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mdzad pa sogs kyi sgo nas dar rgyas su mdzad la 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos kyang de nyid yin te/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i brjod bya zab pa dang rgya che ba'i phyogs gnyis ma lus pa mngon sum du gzigs pa ni sangs rgyas nyag cig yin yang*/ rje btsun 'di nyid ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyis rang gi rgyal tshab du dbang bskur zhing*/ yum gyi mdo'i dgongs pa rdzogs par 'grel ba la bka'i gnang ba dngos su thob par ma zad/ thun mong ma yin par nges pa'i don nyid du rje btsun 'dis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang brnyes pas rang stobs kyis kyang yum gyi mdo'i dgongs pa mtha' dag phyin ci ma log par 'grel nus pa'i phyir/ gal te 'dir rgyan gyi mtshan la bstan bcos zhes 'byung bas rje btsun nyid byang sems dngos min nam zhe na/ skyon med de/ bstan bcos kyi sgra bshad du yod pa la dgongs zhing*/ gdul bya thun mongs ba rnams rjes su gzung ba'i ched du rje btsun nyid byang sems kyi tshul bstan pa'i dbang du byas nas re zhig de ltar du khas len pa mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ des na bstan bcos 'di'i tshig don 'chad par byed pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba spyi'i rnam gzhag bshad pa dang*/ skabs su babs pa'i gzhung don so sor bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyid thar 'dod kyi 'jug ngogs su bstan nas de la 'jug pa'i tshul bshad pa dang*/ rgyan gyi mdo 'chad pa'i bshad thabs ji ltar yin pa'i tshul bshad pa dang bcas pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ thar 'dod kyi skyes bu rnams kyi 'jug ngogs bla na med pa ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid yin la/ de yang rgyal ba dang des bstan pa'i chos dang de sgrub pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su song ba'i sgo nas de'i bstan pa la 'jug rigs pa yin te/ spel mar bstod pa las/ de ring gang la skyab su mchi/ /gang la nyes pa thams cad kun/ /gtan nas yong ye mi mnga' zhing*/ / gang zhig la ni yon tan kun/ /rnam pa kun tu gnas gyur pa/ /gal te sems zhig yod na ni/ /de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro zhing*/ /de bstod de ni bkur ba dang*/ /de'i bstan la gnas par rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'jug bya rgyal ba'i bstan pa de la gnyis yod de/ lung gi bstan pa dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis la 'jug pa'i tshul yod de/ lung gi bstan pa la 'chad nyan dang 'brel ba'i thos bsam gyi sgo nas 'jug pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa la nyams len dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'jug dgos pa'i phyir/ bstan pa gnyis 'dzin pa yang tshul de gnyis kyi sgo nas yin te/ de skad du'ang mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnams gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang*/ /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lung gi bstan pa la thos bsam gyis 'jug tshul yod de/ sde snod dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ci rigs dang por gzhan la thos nas gzhan stobs kyis nges par byed pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa thos pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa yin la/ de nas de'i don rang stobs kyis nges par byed pa ni bsam pa'i sgo nas 'jug tshul yin pa'i phyir/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa la sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'jug tshul yod de/ bslab gsum yan lag dang bcas pa ci rigs rang rgyud la bsten nas gzhung don la yang yang dpyod cing 'dris pa dang de la yid rtse gcig tu gnas par byed pa dang*/

'ga' zhig la 'dor len tshul zhin du byed pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun gyi mdo'i don bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas bshad pa yin te/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ 'tshams sbyar/ brgal lan dang lnga'i sgo nas 'chad par byed pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyed nyid lam/ /zhes sogs kyis dgos don dang*/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang*/ /zhes pa nas don bsdus gzhan te rnam pa gsum/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi bsdus don dang*/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa nyi shu bdun du bzhed/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi tshig don dang*/ de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /zhes pa nas/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i/ /zhes pas 'tshams sbyar dang*/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /zhes sogs dang*/ de la klan ka spangs pa yis/ /zhes sogs dang*/ dngos po brjod du med pa la/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /zhes sogs kyis brgal lan gyi sgo nas bshad cing 'tshams sbyar phal cher shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/ bshad thabs de ltar bstan pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ dgos don gyis dgos pa dang*/ bsdus don gyis lam gyi lus dang*/ tshig don gyis mtha' chod pa dang*/ 'tshams sbyar gyis snga phyi'i 'brel dang*/ brgal lan gyis 'gal med du shes par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yang rnam bshad rig pa las/ mdo don smra ba rnams la ni/ /man ngag sbyin cung zad sbyin par bya/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*/ /tshig don bcas dang 'tshams sbyar bcas/ /brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya/ /zhes dang*/ thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya/ /de sgrub de ni bsdus don la/ /bsdus pa'i don ni tshig don las/ /go rim rigs pa snga phyi dag /mi 'gal ba ni gnyis las so/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa skabs su babs pa'i gzhung don so sor bshad pa la/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ 'jug gi don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan gyi don dang*/ 'gyur gyi phyag bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan bsgyur ba dang mtshan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po/ bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la ci bya zhe na/ de yang rgya gar gyi skad du a bhi sa ma ya zhes sogs su 'bod pa yin te/ bod skad du de la a bhi sa ma ya ni mngon par rtogs pa/ a lang ka ra ni/ rgyan/ nā ma ni zhes bya ba/ pradzñā ni shes rab/ pā ra mi ta ni pha rol tu phyin pa/ u pa de sha ni man ngag /shāst+ra ni bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ bstan bcos 'di chos can khyod kyi mtshan la de ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod la brten nas yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum gyi don rtogs par byed pas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phy-in pa'i man ngag /'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa na bstan bcos/ don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad gsal bar ston pas na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir rgyan gyi don gtso bor gsal byed kyi rgyan la byed pa yin te/ skyes bu'i lus bzang po rgyan gyis spras pa gsal byed me long nang du shar ba dga' ba bskyed pa ltar yum gyi lus bzang po la mdzes byed don bdun cus spras pa gsal byed bstan bcos 'dir snang bas mkhas pa rnams dga' ba bskyed pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa 'gyur phyag ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni shes bya chos can/ 'gyur gyi phyag yod de/ ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs shing shes bya la blo rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhung don bshad pa la/ bshad pa la 'jug pa dang*/

bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bcas pa dang gnyis/ dang po de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams/ zhes pa nas/ yum de la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes pa'i bar gsung*/ 'di'i don la yum mkhyen gsum la bstod pa dang de la phyag 'tshal ba dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ rigs can gsum las rten nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rang don du sdug kun spangs pa'i zhi ba myang 'das 'tshol ba po rnams chos can/ khyod 'bras bu sdug kun nye bar zhi ba'i nyer zhir 'khrid pa'i thabs yod de/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i kun shes de gzhi shes gang yin pa'i thabs de nyid kyis 'khrid par mdzad pa'i phyir/ rten 'gro la phan bsgrub par byed pa'i byang 'phags rnams chos can/ khyod kyis 'bras bu 'jig rten gdul bya rigs can gsum gyi don sgrub pa'i thabs yod de/ lam gsum bdag med par rtogs pa'i lam shes gang yin pa'i thabs de nyid kyis 'khrid par mdzad pa'i phyir/ rten thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu brjod bya rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i sde snod rin po che sna tshogs pa 'di gsungs pa'i thabs yod de/ chos rnams kyi ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyi rnam pa thams cad bdag med rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen gang dang yang dag ldan pa'i thabs de la brten nas bskor ba'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum chos can/ 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don sgrub nus pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin te/ rang sras nyan thos 'phags pa dang byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas ba ste rang rgyal dang sangs rgyas 'phags pa rnams kyi bzhed don sgrub pa'i yon tan rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun chos can/ khyod kyis rgyan rtsom pa'i thog mar yum mkhyen gsum la phyag 'tshal ba yin te/ rang don dang gzhan don gyi dgos pa gnyis kyi sgo nas gus par 'dud pa'i phyir/ gal te tshig rkang gsum pa'i gang zhes pa spyi sgra yin pas bye brag rnam mkhyen la ji ltar go zhe na/

de rnam mkhyen la go bar thal/ spyi sgra yin kyang mkhyen gsum bstod pa'i skabs dang*/ thub rnams zhes pa'i tshig dang 'brel bas de la go ba'i phyir/ kha cig tshigs rkang dang bar gnyis kyi skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang*/ rgyu lam shes med gsung ba ni mi 'thad de/ nyan rang gnyis nyer zhir 'khrid pa'i thabs la ni rang rgyud kyi gzhi zhes dgos shing*/ byang 'phags rnams kyis rang rgyud kyi lam shes la brten nas rigs can gsum gyi don sgrub bar mdzad pa'i phyir te/ de rnams kyi rang rgyud kyi lam la ma brten par 'brel med gzhan zhig la brten nas de ltar mi nus pa'i phyir/ des na tshig rkang dang bar gnyis kyis rim pa bzhin mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang*/ rgyu lam shes dngos su bstan par 'dod dgos te/ gzhan du don med kyi tshig tsam zhig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'o na/ 'dir bstan bcos lus kyi rim pa dang mi mthun par dang por gzhi shes de la bstod pa ci yin zhe na/ de ltar bstod pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i lam nyams len gyi rim pa dang mthun par bstod pa'i phyir/ de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byas rnam mkhyen thob pa la/ lam shes rang rgyud la bskyed pa sngon du 'gro dgos shing*/ de'i sngon du skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong ba'i bsam pa sbyong dgos pa'i rim pa dang mthun par bstod pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag las thar 'dod med na ni lam shes mi skye la/ de ma skyes na/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen 'thob bar mi 'gyur pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bshad pa nye bar dgod pa la/ dgos don dang*/ /bsdus don dang*/ tshig don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po de nyid ston pa la/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam/ /zhes pa nas/ bya ba brtsams pa'i dgos pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsung*/

ngag don ni/ bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan chos can/ khyod brtsams pa la yum gyi mdo dang zlos pa'i skyon med cing dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas yum gyi mdo'i don bde blag tu rtogs pa zhes bya ba de khyod brtsams pa'i dgos pa yin pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos 'di chos can/ dgos pa khyad par can dang ldan te/ khyod la brten nas rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu yi bdag nyid can gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsung gyi don thos bsam gyi dran pa la bzhag nas blo gros dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'di chos can/ brjod bya khyad par can dang ldan te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid kyis mngon sum du gzigs shing*/ der bsgrod pa'i lam rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu po gnas skabs don mngon par rtogs pa brgyad du phye ba ston pas yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum po 'di las bshad pa gang yin pa de khyod kyi brjod bya yin pa'i phyir/ khyod kyi brjod bya'i rim pa de rnams chos can/ gang zag gang yang rung bas rdzogs bar nyams su myong ba ma yin te/ phyi rol pa dang nyan rang la sogs pas gzhan gyi rang lam nas rdzogs par nyam su len mi nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsdus don bshad pa la/ lus mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ 'chad bya 'chad byed mdor bstan pa dang*/ 'chad byed kyi rkang grangs bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /ces gsung*/ ngag don ni/ bstan bcos 'di chos can/ khyod kyis gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum kyi don ni phyin ci ma log par gtan la phab pa yin te/ khyod kyis brjod byed la skabs brgyad dang brjod bya la dngos po brgyad du phye ba de nyid kyis yang dag par bshad pa'i phyir/

gnyis ba 'chad byed kyi rkang grangs ngos bzung nas 'chad par byed pa la/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /zhes pa nas/ /chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad/ /ces pa'i bar gsung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ mkhyen pa gsum yod de/ shes bya'i rnam pa kun mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen nyid dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes nyid dang*/ de nas mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po thams cad shes pa'i gzhi shes nyid dang gsum yod pa'i phyir /de chos can/ sbyor ba bzhi yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang*/ de'i rnam pa sgom pa la gom pa dbang du gyur pa'i rtse mor phyin pa'i rtse sbyor dang*/ de'i rnam pa sgom pa la brtan pa thob pa mthar gyis sbyor ba dang*/ skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ba'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mthar thug 'bras bu chos sku yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku dang bcas pa de ltar na grangs rnam pa brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'dir rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ chos bcu mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug de skabs 'dir bstan pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ sangs rgyas kyis sa kho na la yod pa'i phyir/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de laṃ shes gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na gnyis yod de/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i lam shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/

gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa dang*/ /theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gang rung gis bsdus pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang*/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ mkhyen gsum gang rung gi rnam pa zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sbyor bas rdzogs par bsgom pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum yod pa'i phyir*/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen sbyor lam thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi mkhyen gsuṃ gang rung gi rnam pa nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na bzhi yod de/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor nas bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi bar bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ mthar gyis sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ mkhyen gsum gang rung gi rnam pa la brtan pa thob phyir du bsgom pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyin yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na bcu gsum ste/ phyin drug rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba drug dang*/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis sbyor ba gsum dang*/ lha dang gtong ba dang tshul khrims rjes su dran pa'i de gsum dang dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/

theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar yod pa'i phyir/ skad cig sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ rtsol ba gcig gi byed pa la brten nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum go rim ma 'chol bar rdzogs par bsgom pa'i nus pa thob pas rab tu phye ba'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na bzhi yod de/ rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang*/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i de dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa'i de dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ rgyun mtha'i sbyor dngos gang rung kho na la yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu chos sku'i mtshan nyid yod de/ sbyor bzhi bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i thob bya mthar thug de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na bzhi yod de/ ngo bo nyid sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku/ ye shes chos sku rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na la yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*/ /zhes ba nas/ rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /ces pa'i bar gsung*/ 'di'i skabs su/ mkhyen gsum gyi lus rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ sbyor bzhi'i lus rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ chos sku'i lus rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen dang lam shes dang gzhi shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshon byed kyi chos bcu ngos bzung ba dang*/ bstan bshad sbyar ba dang gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ sems bskyed pa dang zhes pa nas/ nges par 'byung bcas rnams zhes pa'i bar gsung*/ 'di la'ang*/ tshig don dang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ shes bya chos can/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu yod de/ dang po bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ gnyis pa gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa'i gdams ngag dang*/

gsum pa sgrub pa'i ngo bo nges 'byed yan lag rnam pa bzhi dang*/ bzhi ba sgrub pa y-i ni rten gyur ba chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'i theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs dang*/ lnga pa theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dag dang*/ drug pa de'i ched du gnyer bya chen po gsum dang*/ bdun pa phyin drug nyams su len pa'i go cha'i sgrub pa dang*/ brgyad pa sbyor ba'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i 'jug sgrub dang*/ dgu pa tshogs sgrub pa bcu pa nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa dang bcas pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ gzhan don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs shing rang gi grogs rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo'i rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen gtso bo yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na nyer gnyis yod de/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed nas sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar nyer gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi ched du gnyer bya thob pa'i thabs ma nor bar 'doms pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bkar gyur pa'i theg chen gyi brjod byed rnam dag de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ rjes dran gyi gdams ngag dang*/ 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ lam ma zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang gi nyer len du gyur pa'i theg chen thar pa cha mthun rdzogs rjes su byung ba'i theg chen gyi don mngon rtogs de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/

dbye na bzhi yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam kho na la yod pa'i phyir/ rigs kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs dang rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen sbyor lam thob pa'i theg chen sgrub pa'i chos nyid gang zhig /theg chen sgrub pa'i dngos kyi rten gzhi byed pa de/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ spyir chos dbyings gang zhig /ngo bo nyid skur 'gyur rung de/ rang bzhin gnas rigs kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na spyir lam du zhugs ma zhugs kyi dbye bas gnyis yod kyang 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i dbang du byas na du ma yod de/ bcu gsum yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ rigs tsam dang rang bzhin gnas rigs ni sems can thams cad la khyab kyang*/ theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar dang*/ 'dir dngos bstan ni theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i sgro 'dogs gcad gzhi de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum yod de/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams ni phyogs re ba ma yin te/ shes bya thams cad la khyab pa'i phyir/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba mthar thug gi mtshan nyid yod de/ gang gi ched du byang sems sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i thob bya mthar thug de de'i mtshan nyin yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na spyir mang yang 'dir dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas na gsum ste/ sems spong ba rtogs pa chen po gsum yod pa'i phyir/

sgrub pa bzhi'i dang po go sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ phar phyin re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na so drug ste/ sbyin pa'i go sgrub nas shes rab kyi go sgrub gi bar so drug yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ 'jug sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam thob pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i bsgoms byung gi shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas theg pa chen po'i rgyu 'bras kyi chos ci rigs pa sbyor ba lag len gtso bor byas nas nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ dgu yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang 'bras gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi byang chen gang rung dngos su 'byin pas rab tu phye ba'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyin yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yod de/ rang 'bras rnam mkhyen gdon mi za bar 'byin par byed pa'i dag sa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ dag pa sa gsum kho na la yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces gsung*/ ngag don ni/ chos bcu po mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ rnam pa kun mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa nyid yin te/ thub pa'i dbang po'i mngon rtogs mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ 'dis chos bcus rnam mkhyen mtshon tshul bstan pa yin te/

de yang rgyus 'bras bu mtshon tshul la cung zad bshad du rung mod/ slob dpon gyis yul gyis yul can mtshon pa'i dbang du mdzad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ ji ltar mtshon na bshad du yod de/ sems bskyed sogs chos bcu po mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes ni rnam mkhyen du 'jog go zhes pa'i tshul gyis mtshon pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshon byed kyi chos dang*/ bstan bshad sbyar ba dang gnyis/ dang po de nyid 'chad pa la/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bya ba 'di nyid sgom pa'i lam/ /zhes pa'i bar gsung*/ 'di'i skabs su tshig don dang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam shes mtshon byed gyi chos bcu gcig yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i 'od mog mog por byed pa la sogs pas bstan pa'i lam shes kyi yan lag lnga dang*/ slob ma nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang*/ bse ru rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang*/ tshe 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyi phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam dang*/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ mos pa bsgom lam dang*/ phan yon bstod dang bkur dang bsngags pa'i sgom lam dang*/ dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang*/ de la rjes yi rang ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang*/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ shin tu rnam dag sgom lam zhes bya ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i lam shes kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid yod de/ lam shes rdzogs byed kyi khyad par du gyur pa'i sems dpa'i yon tan de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na lnga yod de/ der gyur pa'i gegs mngon pa'i nga rgyal mngon 'gyur ba dang bral ba sogs rnam pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/

sa mtshams yod de/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ sems bskyed bsngo ba shes rab gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i rgyu lam shes dang 'bras bu lam shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye ba dang sa mtshams yod de/ sngar ltar yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye ba dang sa mtshams yod de/ sngar ltar yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis te/ der gyur pa'i mnyam rjes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ mnyam bzhag la dbye na du ma yod de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ sa dang po'i dkyil stod na yod pa'i phyir/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid yod de/ theg chen sgom lam bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na lnga ste/ der gyur pa'i skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu sogs lnga yod pa'i phyir sa mtshams yod de/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa ni theg chen gyi sgom lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar yod cing spyir lam ma zhugs nas yod par khas blangs kyang mi 'gal snyam du sems pa'i phyir/

mos pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ yum rang 'bras don gsum po gang yang rung ba'i 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum yod de/ rang don mos pa sgom lam sogs gsum yod pa'i phyir*/ mos pa sgom lam gyi phan yon gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ mos pa sgom lam sgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gang yang rung bas thugs dgyes pa'i cha dang de gang yang rung bas dngos gnas gyi yon tan brjod pa'i cha gang rung du dmigs pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na nyer bdun yod de/ der gyur pa'i bstod bkur bsngags pa gsum po re re la'ang dgu dgu yod pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa yul khyad par can du sgyur bar byed pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ sa bcu'i rjes thob kyi gnas skabs na yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan rjes su yi rang sgom lam kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa la dga' ba sgom pa'i rang gi grogs yid bde dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gnyis yod cing*/ sa mtshams sngar ltar yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ gtso bor rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed kyi theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam de de'i mtshan nyin yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na lnga yod/ rnam dag sgom lam kyi mtshan nyid yod de/

gtso bor spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed kyi theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis lag rjes 'jog tshul gyi sgo nas so sor bshad pa yin gyi 'gal ba ni ma yin te/ ngo bo sa mtshams sogs sa bcu'i mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs na yod par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig /sa dang po'i gnas skabs su sgrub pa sgom lam dang rnam dag sgom lam yod kyang mos pa sgom lam med zer ba mi 'thad de/ rnam bshad las/ rang don mos ba sgom lam gtso che ba'i dbang du byas te ma dag sa bdun du bzhag par bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi/ /lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad/ /ces gsung*/ ngag don ni/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi/ /lam shes nyid ni chos can/ khyod mtshon byed kyi chos sngar ltar yin te/ mtshon byed de 'dra bar yum gyi mdo las bshad pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ rgyu ngo bo byed las ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshon pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gzhi shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshon byed kyi chos dang*/ bstan bshad sbyar ba dang gnyis/ dang po de nyid 'chad pa la/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ /zhes pa nas/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gsung*/ 'di la'ang tshig don dang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ shes bya chos can/ gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu yod de/ shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i lam shes dang*/ snying rje zhi la mi gnas pa'i lam shes dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa min pas 'bras yum la ring pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ thabs la mkhas pas ring ba ma yin pa 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes dang*/ mi 'thun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang*/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang*/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba dang*/ de'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid dang*/ 'da' bya 'da' byed kyi mthong lam rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ gzhi kun rdzob la ltos te/ srid mtha' 'gog byed kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi kun rdzob la ltos te zhi mtha' 'gog byed kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i lam shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa'i phyir/ mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ 'bras yum la ring pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyi zin pa'i sgo nas theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid snga ma la gnyis yod de/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma la'ang gnyis yod te/ der gyur pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu lam shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ snga ma dang 'dir theg dman 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis don gcig la/ phyi ma theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis don gcig par 'jog tu rung ba'i phyir/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid sogs kyang sngar dang 'dra'o/ /sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyin yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/ rnam pa bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba'i yul yul can bden stong mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes/

sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba'i 'dzin stangs mnyam nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi ste/ zin byed kyi sgo nas bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ bden pa mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir dbye na gnyis te/ 'da' bya 'da' byed kyi mthong lam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ / ces gsung*/ ngag don ni/ sngar bshad pa'i nyan rang byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs de chos can/ kun shes te gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos yin te/ de 'dra nyid du byams mgon nyid kyis 'dod pa'i phyir/ mtshon tshul yod de/ ngo bo dang zin byed kyi sgo nas mtshon pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbyor bzhi'i lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ mthar gyis sbyor ba/ skad cig sbyor ba'i lus rgyas par bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ mtshon byed dang*/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ rnam pa sbyor ba bcas rnams dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ thabs mkhas bcas pa yin zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la'ang tshig don dang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig yod de/ sems dpa'i sbyor ba'i rnam pa dang*/ sbyor bar bcas pa'i rten gyi gang zag dang*/ sbyor ba'i yon tan dang*/ de'i sbyor ba'i skyon dang*/ lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid dang bcas pa dang*/ thar pa cha mthun dang*/ nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs rtags dang bcas pa dang*/ srid pa dang zhi ba mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba dang*/ zhing dag bla na med pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ thabs mkhas sbyor ba dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bstan gnyen po'i mtshan nyid yod de/

rang yul gyi rnam pa legs par shar ba'i sgo nas rang gi dmigs pa'i chos la phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs la dngos su gnod byed kyi mkhyen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas gsum yod pa'i phyir/ rnam pa'i dbang du byas na gnyis yod de/ don rnam dang shes rnam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ 'dir bstan gnyen po ni tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi bar yod la/ spyir lam ma zhugs na'ang yod pa'i phyir/ rnam pa la khyab che chung yod de/ don rnam ni shes bya thams cad la khyab cing*/ shes rnam ni lam ma zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar yod pa'i phyi te/ don rnam dang bsgom bya'i rnam pa rnam grangs yin la/ shes rnam ni spyir shes pa thams cad la khyab cing*/ sgom byed kyi shes rnam ni mi mthun phyogs ci rigs kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i shes pa zhig la byed pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan sems dpa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ rang yul bden med du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyin yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na nyi shu yod de/ der gyur pa'i ngo bo'i sbyor ba lnga dang gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i sbyor ba bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon/ sems dpa'i sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu bzhi dang*/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i sbyor ba skye ba dang gnas pa gang rung la gegs byed de/ sems dpa'i sbyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na zhe drug yod cing*/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes/

lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi ste/ shes mtshan khyad mtshan byed mtshan ngo bo nyid mtshan dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen tshogs lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig gi rigs pa myong ba thon pa'i theg chen gyi chos mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum ste/ chung 'bring chen po gsum yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ gtso bor thabs kyi cha khyad par du byas pa'i theg chen gyi don mngon rtogs de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na bzhi ste/ der gyur pa'i drod sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ snga phyi'i sa mtshams kyi khyad par yod de/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i dbang du byas na rim pa bzhin du dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen tshogs sbyor nyid na yod pa'i phyir/'dir bstan phyir mi ldog pa'i don yang yod de/ lam gzhan gyi bar ma chod par bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ba nges pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum ste/ der gyur pa'i sbyor lam pa sogs yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs la bden zhen mngon 'gyur pa ldog pa sogs rtags nyi shu po gang rung thob pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun la gnas pa'i sems dpa'/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na du ma yod de/ der gyur pa'i bzhi dang rtags gyi dbang du byas na nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod yan chad na yod pa'i phyir/ mthong lam pa dang sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang dbye ba'ang shes par bya'o/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs su srid zhi bden stong mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa la brten nas rjes kyi gnas skabs su bden 'dzin mngon 'gyur ba skye ba'i go skabs bcom pa'i dag pa'i sa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/zhing dag sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/

rten gyi gang zag gang du 'tshang rgya 'gyur gyi zhing khyad par can 'grub pa'i dge rtsa nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i dag sa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yod de/ 'bad rtsol rags pa zhi ba'i sgo nas 'phrin las lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dag sa'i ye shes de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de gsum po mi 'gal te yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ /dbye na re re la'ang gnyis gnyis yod de/ mnyam rjes gnyis gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum ka'ang dag sa kho nar yod/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ste/ /zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ sngar bshad pa'i bcu gcig po 'di chos can/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed yin te/ ngo bo byed las khyad chos ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rtse sbyor kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshon byed dang*/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ de yi rtags dang rnam 'phel dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ log par sgrub dang bcas pa ni/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad yod de/ sbyor lam drod thob pa de'i rtags bcu gnyis po gang rung dang ldan pa'i nges cha dang po dang*/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba sogs bcu drug po gang rung thob pa'i nges cha gnyis pa dang*/ gzhan don la brtan pa thob pa'i nges cha gsum pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la sems kun du gnas pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha bzhi pa dang*/ mthong la rtse sbyor dang sgom lam rtse sbyor zhes bya ba gnyis po so so la gzugs 'dzin gyi rnam par rtogs pa bzhi'i gnyen po bzhi bzhi dang*/ bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bsal bya log par sgrub pa dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ /shes bya chos can/

drod rtse sbyor sogs kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su chos thams cad bden med du mngon sum du rtogs nas rmi lam lta bur lta ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu gnyis po gang rung thob pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha dang po drod rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ bsod nams rnam par 'phel pa'i rtags bcu drug po gang rung thob pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha gnyis pa/ rtse mo'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ thabs shes kyi rtogs pa brtan po gnyis thob pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha gsum pa/ 'dir bstan bzod pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ bsod nams mang pos mtshon te bstan pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha bzhi pa/ 'dir bstan chos mchog /rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ mthong spang rtog pa'i gnyen po byed pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ sgom spang rtogs pa'i gnyen po byed pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na re rela'ang bzhi bzhi yod de/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa kun btags dang lhan skyes bzhi bzhi'i gnyen po bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams yod de/ dang po theg chen gyi mthong lam dang*/ phyi ma sa bcu ba'i gnas skabs su yod pa'i phyir/ bar chad med ba'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yod de/ bsod nams mang pos mtshon te bstan pa'i sgo nas gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra mo dngos su 'joms byed kyi theg chen gyi bar chad med lam de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dang rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gnyis don cig cing*/ sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho na la yod/ bden gnyis gzhi gcig gi steng du 'dur mi rung bar 'dzin pa'i log rtog chos can/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i bsal bya log rtog gi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na du ma yod de/

bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ rtse mo'i mngon rtogs/ zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ sngar bshad pa'i brgyad po de rnams chos can/ rtse mo'i mngon rtogs mtshon byed kyi chos yin te/ de'i ngo bo yon tan spang bya ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mthar gyis sbyor pa'i lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshon byed dang*/ bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam gsum rnam bcu zhes gsung*/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gsum yod de/ phar phyin drug gi mthar gyis sbyor ba drug dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun lha gtong ba tshul khrims te rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis sbyong ba drug dang*/ dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis sbyor ba gcig ste/ de ltar na rnam pa gsum dang bcas pa'i bcu gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad par/ mthar gyis pa zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ sngar bshad pa de dag chos can/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed gyi chos yin te/ de ngo bo dang khyad par gyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa/ skad cig sbyor ba'i lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshon byed dang bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi/ zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ skad cig sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi yod de/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa'i mtshan nyid kyis dbye ba rnam pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de yang yod de/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ rnam par ma smin pa dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ chos bzhi po de chos can/ skad cig ma cig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ba'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos yin te/ de ngo bo dang nus pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku'i lus rgyas par bshad pa la/

mtshon byed dang bstan bshad gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa/ ngo bo nyid yongs rdzogs bcas dang*/ zhes pa nas/ rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ so so'i mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ shes bya chos can/ 'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi yod de/ ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang bcas pa dang*/ de bzhin du de gnyis las gzhan pa sprul pa'i sku dang*/ ye shes chos sku mdzad pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa rnaṃ pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa la/ shes bya chos can/ ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid yod de/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid kyi sku de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i byir/ dbye na gnyis yod de/ glo bur rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang*/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi char gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ longs sku'i mtshan nyid yod de/ nges pa lnga dang ldan pas rab tu phye ba'i gzugs sku mthar thug de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ longs sku chos can/ nges pa lnga dang ldan pa yinate/ sku nges pa mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs dang*/ 'khor nges ba byang 'phags sha stag gis bskor ba dang*/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul mi ston par bzhugs pa dang*/ chos nges pa theg pa chen po'i chos 'ba' zhig gsungs pa dang*/ gnas nges pa 'og min kho nar bzhugs pa'i nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/sprul sku'i mtshan nyid yod de/ nges pa lnga dang mi ldan pa'i gzugs sku de de'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na gsum yod de/ bzo bo sprul sku/ skye ba sbrul sku/ mchog gi sbrul sku dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi chos sku zhes pa'i gzhung 'di gsungs*/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sngar bshad pa'i chos bzhi po de 'bras bu chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos yin te/

de ngo bo dang byed las ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ de mi 'thad par thal/ chos sku zhes pa'i tshig de bstan bshad sbyor ba'i gzhung ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de ye shes chos sku'i lus 'chad byed kyi gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ skyon med de/ de de gny-is ka 'chad byed kyi gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ de bstan bshad sbyor ba'i gzhung du sbyar zhing slob dpon seng ge bzang pos ye shes chos sku'i lus rgyas par bshad ba'i gzhung du sbyar bas gang byas kyang mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ gsum pa tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas 'chad pa la/ mkhyen gsum rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ sbyor bzhi rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ chos sku rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ rnam mkhyen bshad pa dang*/ lam shes bshad pa dang*/ gzhi shes bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po de 'chad par byed pa la/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin zhes bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la'ang mtshon byed kyi chos bcu'i nang nas/ dang po sems bskyed 'chad pa la/ sems bskyed pa ni zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ mtshan nyid dang rab dbye ba'i sgo nas 'chad tshul gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ gzhan gyi phyir du rang gi grogs yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo'i rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen gtso bo'i yid kyi rnam rigs khyad par can chos can/ khyod theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i don ldog yin pa'i phyir/dmigs yul byang chub de dang gzhan gyi don de ni chos can/ yum gsum ka las kyang bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod pa yin te/ yum bar ma las bstan pa de bzhin du gzhan gnyis las kyang bstan pa'i phyir/

'dir theg chen sems bskyed la 'dod pa'i sgras bstan pa'i dgos pa yod de/ gzhan don 'dod pa sems bskyed kyi rgyu dang*/ byang chub 'dod pa grogs su 'byung bar shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen sems bskyed de yang chos can/ khyod la dbye na rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de/ dkar chos kyi rten gzhi byed pa'i sa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te byang chub kyi bar du mi nyams pa'i gser lta bu dang*/ dge ba'i chos gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i zla ba lta bu dang*/ mkhyen gsum bsgoms pa la sgrib pa'i bud shing mngon 'gyur ba sreg pa'i me lta bu dang*/ longs spyod kyis sems can tshim par byed pa'i gter lta bu dang*/ yon tan rin po che'i rten byed pa'i rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu dang*/ mi 'dod ba thog tu bab kyang mi 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ theg chen gyi lam la mi phyed pa'i brtan pa thob pa'i rdo rje lta bu dang*/ g.yeng ba'i rnam rtog gis mi bskyod pa'i ri rab lta bu dang*/ nyon mongs ba'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i sman lta bu dang*/ sems can yongs su mi gtong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu dang*/ mngon shes kyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa'i yid bzhin nor bu lta bu dang*/ gdul bya smin par byed pa'i nyi ma lta bu dang*/ chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i glu lta bu dang*/ mthu thogs pa med pas gzhan don sgrub pa'i rgyal po lta bu dang*/ tshogs gnyis kyi mdzod 'dzin pa'i bang mdzod lta bu dang*/ theg chen gyi 'phags pa thams cad kyang de nas gshegs shing gshegs par 'gyur bas lam po che lta bu dang*/ srid zhi'i mthar mi ltung bar bgrod pa'i bzhon pa lta bu dang*/ chos kyi mdzod mi zad pa 'dzin pa'i bkod ma'i chu lta bu dang*/ gdul bya rnams la chos kyi snyan pa sgrogs pa'i sgra snyan lta bu dang*/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i tshul la rgyun mi chad du 'jug pa'i chu bo lta bu dang*/

mdzod bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed rnams kyang phye bas nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ sa dang*/ gser dang*/ zla ba tshes pa dang*/ me dang*/ gter dang*/ rin po che'i 'byung gnas dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ ri'i rgyal po dang*/ sman dang*/ bshes gnyen dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ glu dbyangs dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ /mdzod dang*/ lam bo che dang*/ bzhon pa dang*/ bkod ma'i chu dang*/ sgra snyan dang*/ chu bo dang*/ sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar nyer gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'di'i dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas pa'i sa mtshams kyi khyad par yod de/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs dang po gsum po de theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung 'bring chen bo gsum dang*/ me lta bu'i sems bskyed sbyor lam dang*/ gter lta bu'i sems bskyed nas glu dbyangs lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar bcu po des dang po nas bcu pa'i bar dang*/ rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs lnga po de/ dag pa sa gsum dang*/ tha ma gsum po des bcu ba dang*/ longs sku dang*/ mchog gi sprul sku'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa la rim pa bzhin du sbyor ba'i phyir/ spyir theg chen sems bskyed yin na/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed yin dgos te/ de yin na spyod pa'i rten byed pa'i rigs gnas kyi sems bskyed yin dgos pa'i phyir/ slob pa'i rgyud la chu bo dang sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed yod par khas blangs kyang 'gal ba med de/ dag sa na de dag yod par go ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa gdams ngag 'chad pa la/ sgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni/ /zhes pa nas/ bcu yi bdag nyid shes par bya/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la dbye ba dang*/ dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag de ni chos can/ khyod la bcu yi bdag nyid du shes par bya ste/

sgrub pa'i ngo bo bden gnyis la 'doms pa dang*/ dmigs pa bden pa bzhi rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i dkon mchog gsum dang*/ bya ba ngan par zhen pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ yongs su mi ngal ba dang*/ theg chen gyi lam ni yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ mngon shes kyi yon tan drug dang*/ mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gdams ngag bcas pa bcu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /zhes pa nas/ bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ mtshon bya mtshon byed kyi dge 'dun gyi nang nas mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun nyi shu yod de/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dbang po rtul po dang dbang po rnon po'i ming can gyi byang sems gnyis dag dang*/ shugs bstan rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po pa'i ming can gcig dang*/ phyir 'ong dang*/ /phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i ming can dbang rtul dad mos pa dang dbang rnon mthong thob pa gnyis dang*/ rgyun zhugs rigs nas rigs skye'i ming can gnyis dang*/ shugs bstan phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po pa dang*/ phyir 'ong tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa'i ming can gcig dang*/ phyir mi 'ong bar 'da' ba dang*/ skyes nas 'da' ba dang*/ 'du byed bcas te 'da' ba dang*/ 'du byed min par 'da' ba dang bcas pa'i phyir mi 'ong gi ming can bzhi dang*/ dbye gzhi 'og min 'gro la phye ba'i gong 'pho 'phar ba gsum gyi ming can rnams dang*/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i mthar thug par 'gro ba'i gzugs kyi chags bcom gzhir byas nas de las phyir mi 'ong mthong ba yi chos la zhi ba dang*/ lus mngon sum du byed pa gnyis/ shugs bstan dgra bcom zhugs pa'i ming can gcig dang*/ bser ru rang sangs rgyas kyi ming can gcig ste nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang slob dpon gyi bzhed pa ltar bshad pa yin gyi/ der nges pa ni min te/ slob dpon 'phags pas sngar gyi de dang cung zad mi 'dra bar bshad pa'i phyir/

gsum pa nges 'byed cha 'thun 'chad pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ dmigs pa dag dang rnam pa dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ bcas pa dag las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ byang chub sems dpa' skyobs pa yi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi chos can/ nyan thos bse ru lta bu dang bcas pa'i spyod lam dag las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*/ /rgyu dang yongs su 'dzin pa yis dang*/ bdag nyid shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa bzhi po ji bzhin spang bya'i ngo bor ldan pa la brten pa dang chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ /zhes pa nas/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ bden pa bzhi'i rten can mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po chos can/ theg chen sbyor lam drod chung ngu'i dmigs pa yin te/ de'i sgro 'dogs gcad par bya ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ rtags 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar dgos pa yin te/ thams cad kyi sgro 'dogs gcad gzhi mtshungs pa'i phyir/ bden pa bzhi po de yi ni khyad chos bcu drug la bden par mngon par zhen pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa 'gog pa'i drod chung ngu'i ye shes chos can/ drod chung ngu'i rnam pa yin te/ de'i dmigs pa'i chos la phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs 'gog byed kyi drod chung ngu'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ rnam pa gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar dgos te/ thams cad kyis rang gi dmigs pa'i chos la phyin ci log tu zhen pa'i sgro 'dogs 'gog par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod chung ngu'i ye shes chos can/ rang 'bras khyad par can gyi rgyu byed pa yin te/ theg pa gsum car gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i nye rgyur byed pa'i phyir/

'di yang lhag ma rnams la sbyar dgos te/ nyer 'bras de 'byin par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ drod 'bring gi dmigs rnams kyi khyad par yod de/ gzugs sogs rnams don dam par 'dug go bden pa dang bral bas khyad par du byas nas bden bzhi'i dmigs pa dang*/ ming gi rgyud don dam par gnas pa dang bral ba ste gnas pa med par rtogs pa'i drod 'bring gi ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir /drod chen po'i dmigs rnam yod de/ gzugs sogs brdar btags pas khyad par du byas ba'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang*/ de dag don dam par brjod du med par rtogs pa'i drod chen po'i ye shes rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ /rtse mo chung ngu'i dmigs rnam yod de/ bden pa rnam par bzhag ma gzhag gnyis las phyi ma'i dbang du byas na/ gzugs tshor sogs don dam par mi gnas pa de dag ni don dam par de yi ngo bo rang bzhin med pas khyad par byas pas dmigs pa dang*/ gzugs sogs dang de'i chos nyid de dag bden stong gcig gi rang bzhin gcig tu rtogs pa'i rtse mo'i chung ngu'i ye shes rnam pa dang*/ dang po'i dbang du byas na gzugs sogs de rnams de'i ngo bo bden pas stong pas de dag don dam pa'i mi skye ba la sogs par mi gnas pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang*/ mi rtag sogs dang de'i chos nyid de dag gi bden stong gcig gi rang bzhin gcig tu rtogs pa'i rtse mo'i chung ngu'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtse mo 'bring gi dmigs rnam gyi khyad par yod de/ chos rnams bden grub kyi mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa gang yin pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang*/ de dag bden par grub pa'i mtshan mar mi mthong bar rtogs pa'i rtse mo 'bring gi ye shes rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtse mo chen po'i dmigs rnam yod de/ don dam dpyod byed kyi shes rab kyis ni yongs su rtogs pa'i tshul gyis dpyad pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang*/

'khor gsum thams cad dmigs su med par rtogs pa'i rtse mo chen po'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa chung ngu'i dmigs rnam yod de/ gzugs sogs don dam par ngo bo nyid med pa nyid kyis khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang*/ gzugs sogs de rnams don dam par ngo bo nyid med pa nyid yin kyang tha snyad pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i bzod pa chung ngu'i ye shes rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa 'bring gi dmigs rnam yod de/ gzugs sogs de dag don dam par skye ba med pa dang nges par 'byung ba med pas khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi dmigs pa dang*/ sgo gsum bden grub kyis rnam par dag pa'i bzod pa 'bring gi ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa chen po'i dmigs rnam yod de/ sgo gsum de dag bden grub kyi mtshan ma med pas khyad par du byas pa dmigs pa dang*/ de gsum don dam par de yi mtshan mar mi brten pas yid gnyis kyi mos pa min pa dang 'du shes min pa dang 'du shes med par rtogs pa'i bzod pa chen po'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos mchog chung ngu'i dmigs rnams yod de/ bsgom bya'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bor gyur pa dmigs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin de'i byed pa lhun grub du 'jug par rtogs pa'i chos mchog chung ngu'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos mchog 'bring gi dmigs rnam yod de/ lkog tu lung ston pa'i rgyu khyad par can dmigs pa dang*/ don dam par rlom pa rags pa zad pa'i ye shes de rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos mchog chen po'i dmigs rnam yod de/ 'khor gsum po bden pas stong pa phan tshun ngo bo gcig pa dmigs pa dang*/ chos mchog gi ting nge 'dzin mtha' gang du'ang rnam par mi rtogs par bden med du rtogs pa'i chos mchog chen po'i ye shes de de'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha 'thun chos can/

khyod la rnam pa bcu gnyis yod de/ sngar bshad pa de ltar re re la'ang chung dang 'bring dang chen po'i dbye bas rnam pa bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gzhung de rnams kyis ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul yod de/ shes sgrib spong ba la bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po de bden med du gtso bor bsgom pa nyid gal che zhing*/ de yang theg chen sbyor lam gyi gnas skabs su 'byung gi /theg dman sbyor lam gyi gnas skabs su ni bcu drug po gtso bor bsgom par byed kyang*/ bden med du gtso bor mi bsgom par bstan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtogs pa kun btags dang lhan skyes gnyis ka'i stong nyid gtso bor bsgoms stobs kyis spong bar byed nus kyi/ kha ton byed pa tsam gyis spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi spang bya de 'chad pa la/ gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis/ /zhes pa nas/ phung sogs rten la'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi spang bya yod de/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtogs pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gzung bar rtog pa de chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ gzhi kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs dang*/ de yi gnyen po'i phyogs la brten pa'i dbye ba yis de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis po de ni chos can/ so sor dbye bas rnam pa dgu dgu yod de/ rmongs pa dang mi rtag pa dang phung sogs la dmigs pa'i bye brag gis de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtogs pa'ang chos can/ rnam pa gnyis su 'dod de/ gang zag rnams dang skyes bu btags pa'i rten can gyi dbye bas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis po de ni chos can/ rnam pa dgu dgu yod de/ rang dbang can gyi bdag sogs kyi ngo bo dang*/ phung sogs kyi rten la dmigs pa la de bzhin du yod pa'i phyir/ snga phyi bzhi po de'i khyad par yod de/

spang bya kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs kyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyod bya'am shes byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de shes sgrib nyon mongs gzung rtog dang*/ gnyen po rnam byang phyogs kyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyad bya'am shes byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ shes sgrib rnam byang gzung rtog yin la/ rdzas 'dzin gyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyod byed kyi shes byed du bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ shes sgrib rdzas 'dzin rtogs pa dang*/ rtag 'dzin gyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyod byed kyi shes byed tu dben par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de/ shes sgrib brtags 'dzin rtogs par 'jog pa'i phyir/ de re re la'ang gnyis gnyis yod de/ kun btags dang lhan skyes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas nas kun btags gtso che ste/ lhan skyes ni skabs lnga par byed pa'i phyir/ theg chen sbyor lam pa'i yongs 'dzin de 'chad par byed pa la/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ stong nyid zab mo la sems mi 'gong zhing mi skrag pa nyid la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas dang*/ de'i mi mthun phyogs nyan rang yid byed dang bden zhen ci rigs bor pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ rnam pa kun du byang sems sbyor lam pa'i nang gi yongs 'dzin yin te/ de srid zhi gang rung du mi ltung bar 'dzin par byed pa'i de'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems sbyor lam pa la chos thams cad don dam par ngo bo nyid med pa sogs su ston par byed cing de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba'i mchog gi sprul sku chos can/ byang sems sbyor lam pa'i phyi'i yongs 'dzin yin te/ de la thabs shes rdzogs par ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa theg chen sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnas rigs 'chad pa la/

rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ 'jug pa'i rten la rigs shes bya/ /zhes gsungs/ ngag don ni/ theg chen sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi dang*/ theg chen gyi mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis te rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang*/ gnyen po'i bar chad med lam skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa dang*/ spang bya'i sa bon 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshul gyis spong ba dang*/ spang bya de dag yongs su gtugs pa ste zad pa'i rnam grol lam dang*/ srid zhi'i mtha' 'gog byed shes rab snying brtser bcas pa dang*/ slob ma nyan thos sogs dang thun mong ma yin pa nyid dang*/ gzhan gyi don kyi go rim sgrub pa dang*/ ji lta ji snyed la ye shes rtsol ba rags pa spangs shing*/ /mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi rten chos nyid bcu gsum po de chos can/ khyod la rigs zhes bya ste/ theg chen sgrub pa rang nyid la dmigs nas bsgoms pas de rtogs pa gong 'phel du 'gyur pa'i rigs yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi sa mtshams kyi khyad par yod de/ rtogs pa'i chos drug ni sngar ltar dang*/ gnyen po dang ni spong pa dang*/ zhes bas theg chen mthong sgom gnyis la ni gnyen po'i bar chad me lam dang spong pa'i bar chad med lam gnyis spang bya spong tshul gyis gnyis su phye nas bstan/ de dag yongs su gtugs pa dang zhes pas/ de gnyis gyi rnam grol lam gcig tu byas te sa bdun pa man chad dang*/ shes rab snying brtser bcas pa sa brgyad pa dang*/ slob ma thun mong ma yin pa sa dgu pa dang*/ gzhan don go rims su byed pa dang*/ ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' ba gnyis ka sa bcu ba dang sbyar zhing*/ de yang 'di'i dngos bstan la dgongs pa'i phyir/ rigs la rtsod pa spong pa 'chad pa la/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ /de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la rtsod pa dang*/ lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/

theg pa gsum gyi rigs kyi dbye ba ni tha dad par rung ba ma yin par thal/ de gsum bden pas stong pa'i chos dbyings la ngo bo rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ rigs can gsum ka'i slob ma rnams chos can/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi gnas skabs kyi rigs la gnas par thal/ rtags de'i phyir/ zhe na/ gnyis pa la lan ni/ shes bya chos can/ rigs gsum dang rang bzhin gsum gyi dbye ba mi rung ba'i skyon de med par thal/ de'i chos dbyings kyi ngo bo la rigs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med kyang rten pa'i chos sgrub pa gsum gyi bye brag gis rigs dang rigs can gsum po de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod rigs pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rten bum pa gcig gi nang du brten pa sbrang rtsi dang bu ram sogs blugs pa de'i tshe sbrang rtsi'i bum pa dang*/ bu ram sogs kyi bum pa zhes brjod du rung ba bzhin no/ /gzhung 'dis sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can du bstan pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi sems bden stong de sangs rgyas su 'gyur rung gi rigs su bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ spyir chos thams cad bden pas stong bzhin du bya byed kyi rnam bzhag 'thad pa ltar/ sems can thams cad gyi sems bden pas stong zhing dri ma glo bur pa yin pa la 'khor 'das kyi rnam gzhag thams cad 'thad par/ rgyud bla ma rtsa 'grel las dpe dgu don dgu'i sgo nas rgyas par gtan la phab pa ltar gnyen po dang 'phrad na ni dri ma sbyong nus pas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der ma zad/ 'phags pas chos dbyings bstod pa las kyang*/ gang zhig kun du ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor la/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur 'gyur pa/ /de nyid sbyang ba byas pa las/ /dag pa de ni mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/

/zhes rang bzhin gnas rigs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa dang*/ de nyid sbyangs pa las chos kyi skur 'gyur bar gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa 'chad pa la/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de/ /zhes pa nas/ /gang dag thub pa'i thun mong min/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ dge sogs kyi chos rnams thams cad chos can/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin te/ de'i sgro 'dogs gcad par bya ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ dmigs pa'i chos de yang chos can/ du ma yod de/ dge ba dang*/ la sogs bas mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan dang*/ 'jig rten pa yi rtogs pa phung po lnga dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das par 'dod pa ni bsam gtan bzhi gang dag dang*/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga dang*/ zag pa med pa med pa'i chos dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang*/ 'dus byas khams gsum po gang dag dang*/ 'dus ma byas de bzhin nyid dang*/ slob ma nyan thos dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos bsam gtan bzhi rnams dang*/ thub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i chos gang dag rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ yod na theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa yin pas khyab ste/ de'i sgro 'dogs gcad gzhi yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yod na theg chen sgrub pas rang la dmigs nas bden med du rtogs dgos pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yod na dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum po gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ dge mi dge gang rung ma yin pa'i chos yin na/ lung ma bstan yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de yin na rang 'bras rnam smin yid 'ong dang yid mi 'ong gang rung 'byin rung ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ drug pa/ theg chen sgrub pa'i chad du bya ba 'chad pa la/ sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ ched du bya ba 'dir shes bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ theg chen sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba 'di chos can/

khyod gang gi shes par bya ba'i gang zag yod de/ rang byung gi ming gis brjod pa byang sems rnams kyis shes par bya ba'i phyir/ gang gi sgo nas shes par byed pa yod de/ chen po gsum gyi sgo nas shes par byed pa'i phyir/ chen po gsum yang chos can/ yod de sems can kun gyi mchog nyid du byed pa'i sems chen po dang spong ba chen po dang rtogs pa chen po dang gsum po rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi yod de/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi thugs rje chen po dang po dang*/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das gnyis pa dang*/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ bdun pa go sgrub 'chad pa la/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /zhes pa nas/ drug mtshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin pa de ni chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ mdo las sby-in pa'i sbyin pa sogs drug nas/ shes rab kyi shes rab bar drug tshan drug gi sgo nas ji lta ba bzhin du bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar byed par rung ste/ go cha'i sgrub pa de dag so sor te ris nas kyang sbyin pa la sogs pa rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa 'jug sgrub 'chad pa la/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang*/ zhes pa nas/ 'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ theg chen lam gyis bsdus pa'i bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi dang*/ sbyin sogs drug dang*/ mthong sgom gyi lam dang*/ byams sogs tshad med bzhi dang*/ bden grub kyi dmigs pa med pa dang ldan pa dang*/ gang la gang gis ji ltar sbyin pa'i 'khor gsum bden med du rtogs pa'i rnam par dag pa dang*/ ched du bya ba chen po gsum gyi phyir du bsngo ba'i dge ba dang mngon shes drug dang*/ 'bras bu rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la 'jug pa'i 'jug sgrub kyi ye shes rnams chos can/

theg chen gyi lam la 'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya ste/ theg pa chen po'i rgyu 'bras kyi chos ci rigs pa gong 'phel du 'jug pa'i sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/ dgu pa tshogs sgrub 'chad pa la/ dngos dang 'phros pa'i don sa bcu pa'i yongs sbyong dang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang bcas pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po 'chad pa la/ brtse dang sbyin la sogs pa drug /zhes pa nas/ rim pa yin par shes bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ tshogs sgrub chos can/ khyod nyams su len pa'i rim pa la bcu bdun yod pa yin par shes par bya ste/ de la yang der gyur ba'i brtse ba snying rje chen po dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs drug nyams su len pa dang*/ zhi gnas lhag mthong dang bcas pa dang*/ zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i lam gang yin pa dang*/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas pa gang yin pa dang*/ ye shes dang ni bsod nams kyis btus pa dang*/ mthong sgom gyi lam dang*/ tshig don gyi gzung dang*/ sa bcu dang*/ gnyen po'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi khyad par bcu bdun rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de thams cad bsdus na gnyis su 'du ste/ ye shes dang bsod nams kyi tshogs sgrub gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ dang po yongs sbyong bye brag tu bshad pa la/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ /zhes pa nas/ bcu pa yin par shes bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di la sa dang po'i yongs sbyong bshad pa dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang/ lnga pa dang*/ drug pa dang*/ bdun pa dang*/ brgyad pa dang*/ dgu pa'i yongs sbyong dang*/ bcu pa mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bshad pa dang bcu/ dang po de 'chad pa la/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ /zhes pa nas/ yongs su sbyong ba shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ sa ni dang po/ rab tu dga' ba chos can/ khyod thob par 'gyur ba'i thabs yod de/ 'chad pa ltar yongs su sbyong ba rnam ba bcu yi sgo nas thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/

yongs sbyong bcu yang yod de/ g.yo sgyu sogs med pa'i bsam pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la phan pa'i dngos po nyid dang*/ sems can rnams la tshad med bzhi'i sgo nas sems mnyam pa nyid dang*/ dge rtsa sogs gzhan la gtong ba dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ theg chen gyi sde snod sogs dam pa'i chos kyi dmigs pa 'tshol ba dang*/ rtags tu nges par 'byung ba'i sems dang bcas pa nyid dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par 'dod pa la dga' ba dang*/ chos ston pa la dpe 'khyud med pa dang*/ tshig thams cad bden par smra ba yi/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong ni bcu pa yin par 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyod kyis sa dang po yongs su sbyong bar byed tshul yod de/ snying rje chen po dang 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas de'i skyon sel zhir yon tan rdzogs par byed pa'i tshul gyis shes par bya ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'chad pa la/ tshul khrims byas pa gzo dang bzod/ /zhes pa nas/ brgyad pa sbyin la sogs la brtson/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa gnyis pa'i yongs sbyong brgyad yod de/ tshul khrims kyi nyams len lhag par thob pa dang*/ byas pa bzo ba dang*/ bzod pa sgom pa dang*/ dge ba sgrub par la rab tu dga' ba dang*/ gzhan la snying rtse che ba dang bcas pa dang*/ mkhas sogs bkur sti byed pa dang*/ bla ma la gus pas chos nyan pa dang*/ brgyad pa sbyin pa la sogs kyi nyams len la brtson pa'i yongs sbyong rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'chad pa la/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /zhes pa nas/ rlom med bdag nyid de rnams lnga/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa gsum pa'i yongs sbyong rnam pa lnga yod de/ thos pas mi ngoms pa nyid kyis chos 'tshol ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i zang zing med par chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun sbyong bar byed pa dang*/

'khor ba pas gnod pa byas kyang de'i don la yongs su mi skyo ba dang*/ sdig pa la 'dzem pa'i ngo tsha khrel yod ces bya ba rnams su yod la/ de rnams la rlom sems med pa'i bdag nyid can gyi shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas yongs su sbyong bar byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa 'chad pa la/ nags gnas 'dod chung chog shes dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ mi zhum pa dang lta ba med/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ shes bya chos can /sa bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong la bcu yod de/ nyan rang yid byed kyi bsam pas dben pa'i nang na gnas pa dang*/ 'dod pa chung ba dang*/ chos shes pa dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yang dag par blangs pa'i sdom pa la brten pa dang*/ bslab pa khas slangs yongs su mi gtong ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan la chags pa smod cing spong ba dang*/ gzhan myang 'das la 'god pa dang*/ bdog pa'i dngos po kun gtong ba dang*/ chos kyi dka' spyod la mi zhum pa'i spro ba dang*/ bden grub tu lta ba'i zhen pa med pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa 'chad pa la/ 'dris dang khyim la 'khren pa dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ sa lnga pa ni yang dag thob/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs*/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa lnga pa la yongs sbyong bcu yod de/ rnyed bkur kyi ched du khyim la 'dris pa spong ba dang*/ khyim la 'khren pa'i rkyen gyis gzhan la de mi ston pa dang*/ 'du 'dzir gyur pa'i gnas spong pa dang*/ rnyed bkur gyi ched du bdag la bstod cing*/ gzhan la brnyas pa spong ba gnyis dang*/ mi dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu spong ba dang*/ nga rgyal gyi rlom pas khengs pa spong pa dang*/ dge sdig la blang dor phyin ci log tu byed pa spong ba dang*/ blo ngan 'jig lta spong ba dang*/ nyon mongs phyogs la bzod cing dang du len pa spong ba dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sngar bshad pa ltar bcu po 'di ni chos can/ sbyang gzhi yod de/ mi mthun phyogs rnam pa bcu sbyangs shing rnam par spangs pas na sa lnga pa ni yang dag par thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/

drug pa 'chad pa la/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /zhes pa nas/ sa ni drug pa yang dag thob/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa drug pa la yongs sbyong bcu yod de/ sbyin sogs drug dang de'i spang bya drug sbyar nas sbyong zhing*/ de yang sbyin pa'i nyams len gyis slob ma nyan thos kyi byang chub 'dod pa spong ba dang*/ rang don ni yid byed kyi sems spong ba'i tshul khrims kyis bse ru rang rgyal gyi byang chub la dga' ba spong ba dang*/ stong nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pas zab don la skrag pa'i sems spong pa dang*/ sby-in pa la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyis slong ba pos bslangs pa'i sems mi zhum pa dang*/ sbyin pa la yang sems rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan gyis phyi nang gi bdog pa kun gtang yang yid mi dga' ba med pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i yon tan rtogs pa'i shes rab rab tu rdzogs pas btang bas rang nyid dbul yang slong po mi spong bar bslabs nas sa ni drug pa yang dag par thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de ltar bsdoms na drug yod kyang phye na bcu gnyis su 'gyur te/ spang bya dang spong byed kyi sgo nas so so phye ba bcu gnyis su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bdun pa 'chad pa la/ bdag dang sems can 'dzin pa dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ stong pa nyid dang nyi shu'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'di spang bya dang*/ gnyen po'i sgo nas sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa bdun pa'i yongs sbyong la spang bya spong tshul gyis bzhag pa nyi shu yod de/ 'chad par 'gyur pa ltar nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ spang bya gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ sems can du 'dzin pa dang*/ de bzhin du srog dang*/ rang dbang can gyi gang zag dang*/ sems can chad pa dang*/ bdag rtag pa dang*/ blang dor gyi mtshan ma dang*/ rgyu mi 'dra ba gsum dang*/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dag dang*/ khams gsum po la gnas byar dang*/

dor byar bden par chags pa dang*/ sems ni kun du mi zhum pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum re re dang*/ tshul khrims la der bden par lta ba'i mngon zhen dang*/ stong pa nyid la phyin ci log tu rtsod pa dang*/ bden stong de dang kun rdzob 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i nyes pa ni nyi shu rnams gang las rnam par chad pa'i byang sems de yis sa ni bdun pa thob par 'gyur pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gnyen po'i yongs sbyong nyi shu yod de/ de yang sngar bshad pa'i spang bya nyi shu po rnams kyi gnyen por rim pa bzhin du sbyar na rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid la sogs pa gsum shes pas bdag dang sems can dang srog tu 'dzin pa rnams spong ba dang*/ de dge bcu'i 'khor gsum la bden par zhen pa med pa'i rnam par dag pa nyid kyis rang dbang can gyi sems can du 'dzin pa spong pa dang*/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rjes sems can chad par 'dzin pa spong ba dang*/ bden grub tu rlom pa med pas sems can rtag par 'dzin pa spong pa dang*/ chos thams cad bden stong mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas blang dor mtshan mar 'dzin pa spong pa dang*/ mthar thug theg pa chen po'i tshul gcig tu shes pas rgyu rigs mi 'dra ba gsum tu 'dzin pa spong pa dang*/ 'dus byas rnams don dam par mi skye bar shes pas phung po la bden zhen spong ba dang*/ stong nyid zab mo la bzod pa shes pas khams gsum la bden zhen spong ba dang*/ chos rnams bden stong kyi rnam pa gcig tu ston pas skye mched la bden zhen spong pa dang*/ bden 'dzin gyi rtogs pa kun tu 'joms pas khams gsum la gnas byar bden par zhen pa spong ba dang*/ tshul min yid byed kyi 'du shes dang*/ lta ba lnga dang*/ chags sogs kyi nyon mongs pas khams gsum la dor bya bden par zhen pa spong ba dang*/ zhi gnas nges par sems shing bsgoms pas sems zhum pa spong pa dang*/ lhag mthong gi lam ni mkhas pas sangs rgyas dang*/

sems dul bas chos dang*/ chos thams cad la thog pa med pa'i ye shes dang ldan pas dge 'dun la bden par zhen pa sbong ba gsum dang*/ chos gang la'ang bden par chags pa'i sa min par rtogs pas tshul khrims la bden zhen spong pa dang*/ chos kyi don du gar 'dod par sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du ni dus mnyam du 'gro bas stong pa nyid la rtsod pa spong ba dang*/ gdul bya'i don du 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun tu bdag gi lus kyi ngo bo nyid rab tu ston pa nyid dang nyi shu yod pa'i phyir/ spang bya de rnams ni/ phra rags ci rigs la dgongs pa yin gyi/ phra ba thams cad la min te/ lugs 'dir bden 'dzin ma lus par spangs pa dang sangs rgyas pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa myang 'das 'chad pa la/ sems can kun yid shes pa dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ sa brgyad pa'i yongs sbyong gi las ni chos can/ rnam pa 'di brgyad du bshad pa yin te/ sems can kun gyi yid kyi spyod pa bzang ngan shes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su rdzu 'phrul gyis mngon par shes pas brtse ba dang*/ rang nyid gang du 'tshang rgya 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzang po sgrub pa dang*/ chos kyi tshig yongs su brtags pa'i phyir du sangs rgyas brten pa dang*/ gdul bya rnams kyi dbang po rno rtul shes pa dang*/ rgyal ba yi zhing gi sems can kyi nyon mongs sbyong ba dang*/ de dag thams cad bden stong sgyu ma lta bur bar lta ba la gnas pa dang sems can gyi don du bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba len pa dang brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dgu pa 'chad pa la/ smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa dgu pa la yongs sbyong bcu gnyis yod de/ byang chub tu smon pa'i smon lam dag ni mtha' yas pa dang*/

lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa'i skad shes pa dang*/ spobs pa chu bo lta bur zad mi shes pa dang*/ ma'i mngal du 'jug pa mchog dang*/ rgyal rigs sogs rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ bu ram shing pa ltar rus phun sum tshogs par skye ba dang*/ gnyen gyi cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ brgya byin sogs kyis bstod pa'i skye ba phun sum tshogs pa dag dang*/ sangs rgyas dang lha sogs kyis bskul te nges par 'byung ba dang*/ byang chub kyi shing rnams kyi drung du 'dug pa dang*/ stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rdzogs par byed pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bcu pa mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas 'chad pa la/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni/ /zhes pa nas/ bcu ba yin par shes bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ dman pa'i sa brgyad dang sa dgu pa man chad byang sems kyi sa zhes gcig tu byas na sa dgu'i snga ma brgyad la shes mthong dang phyi ma la gnas nas 'das par byas nas thob pa'i sa bcu pa'i ye shes de ni chos can/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu pa yin par shes par bya ste/ rgyu mtshan gang gis na mdo las/ 'da' byas dgu 'das nas sa bcu pa la gnas pa de la sangs rgyas kyi sar gnas zhes ming gis btags nas bshad pa'i phyir/ sa bcu pa chos can/ khyod 'dir mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dngos su bshad nas yongs sbyong gi sgo nas dngos su ma bshad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod 'da' bya'i sa de dag gi 'bras bu'i sa yin par shes pa dang*/ 'da' bya'i sa dgu po thams cad kyi yon tan gyi rigs yar ldan du yod par shes pa'i ched du yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod sangs rgyas kyi ming gis 'dog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su gzhan don byed pa'i sgo sangs rgyas dang phyogs mthun mnyam pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub 'chad pa la/

/mthong dang goms pa'i lam dag la/ /zhes pa nas/ gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam dang sgom pa'i lam dag chos can/ khyod la gnyen po rnam pa brgyad ces bya ba yod pa yin te/ spang bya shes sgrib gzung rtog dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnam pa nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir du grangs kyi sgo nas brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ shes sgrib kun btags lhan skyes gnyis po re re la'ang nyon mongs gzung rtog dang rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis re dang*/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis re ste so sor phye ba brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ bcu pa nges 'byung sgrub pa 'chad pa la/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin zhes bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don du bsgrim na/ nges par 'byung ba brgyad kyi bdag nyid 'og nas 'byung ba 'di rnams bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams su len pa'i dag sa'i ye shes chos can/ nges 'byung sgrub pa yin par shes par bya ste/ rnam mkhyen gdon mi za bar thob pa byed pa'i dag sa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ nges 'byung sgrub pas 'byung ba'i dbye ba la brgyad yod de/ sngar bshad pa ltar ched du bya ba gsum dang*/ chos thams cad bden stong mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thugs rje dang*/ sems can gyi don rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ don de 'bad med lhun grub tu byed pa dang*/ srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das par nges par 'byung ba dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi thob bya'i rigs thamasacad thob pa'i mtshan nyid nges par 'byung ba dang*/ chos bcu'i rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen nyid dang*/ rnam mkhyen de'i khyad par gyi lam gyi yul can nges par 'byung pa ste brgyad rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i nges 'byung yin na/
